en: Colorized night-view postcard showing a large round red-brick tower with a steep, dark, conical roof and several smaller spires. The moon and clouds dominate the dramatic sky. At the base of the tower are lower buildings with lit windows and people in early-20th‑century clothing walking in the street near a gas streetlamp. Faint red text at the top reads a place name, and white text at the bottom right appears to be a publisher or collection mark.
